title: Wails vs Electron: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Wails vs Electron: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

* Throughput: Wails leverages native Go performance, offering potentially higher throughput than Electron's Node.js base.
* Latency: Wails' direct Go-to-WebView communication can reduce overhead compared to Electron's IPC.
* Consistency: Electron's Chromium bundle ensures consistent rendering, while Wails relies on system WebView, which can vary.
* Failure Modes: Electron's self-contained nature can isolate issues, whereas Wails might be more susceptible to system WebView bugs.
* Operational Overhead: Wails generally has a smaller footprint and faster startup than Electron.

Recommendation: For maximum production scalability and minimal footprint, Wails often has an edge. For guaranteed UI consistency across all systems, Electron remains a strong contender.
